## Run this PR

```bash
# Replace PR_NUMBER with this PR's number
# If PR modifies only one project, prrun will auto-detect it:
prrun https://github.com/neongreen/mono/pull/PR_NUMBER

# Or specify the project explicitly with -p or --project:
prrun https://github.com/neongreen/mono/pull/PR_NUMBER -p PROJECT

# Examples:
# prrun https://github.com/neongreen/mono/pull/PR_NUMBER -p dissect
# prrun https://github.com/neongreen/mono/pull/PR_NUMBER -p markdown-format --help
# prrun https://github.com/neongreen/mono/pull/PR_NUMBER -p dissect myfile.go
```
